problem_statement: When a parent node handles a Child Update Request from a CSL-synchronized child that carries a CSL channel, an invalid channel value is accepted and stored. A channel value outside the supported range (below the minimum, above the maximum, 200, or 0xffff), or a value whose channel page is non-zero (for example 0x0100 plus the minimum channel, which truncates to a valid single-byte channel), is silently taken as the child's CSL channel instead of being rejected. The request must be rejected for any CSL channel value that is neither zero nor within the valid channel range, leaving the child's CSL channel unchanged, while a zero value (unspecified) and an in-range value continue to be accepted.
